name: pdfToImage
description: Rasterises a 1-based page of a PDF into an ordinary image object, so the whole image* family (resize, crop, watermark, write in any format) applies to the result. width wins if given; otherwise dpi is used (PDF's native resolution is 72dpi, so dpi/72 is the scale); otherwise 1:1. The output canvas is capped at 40 megapixels regardless of what the page declares — if exceeded, the scale is reduced to fit rather than the call failing.

params.name: pdfObj
params.description: A PDF object from pdfRead() or pdf().

params.name: width
params.description: Target width of the rendered image in pixels. Wins over dpi when given.

params.name: dpi
params.description: Target resolution in DPI. Used when width is not given (scale = dpi / 72).

examples.title: Render page 1 to a 400px-wide PNG
examples.description: Rasterise the first page and write it to disk.
